name: Post-Holiday Roast Turkey & White Bread Sliders with Cranberry Spread
whyItWorks: Soft Hawaiian rolls or white bread layered with cold sliced roast turkey breast and a thin spread of smooth, strained cranberry sauce. Seed-free, low-residue, and soothing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Layer cold roast turkey breast onto soft white rolls with light mayo and a thin layer of jellied cranberry sauce.
watchOuts: Use smooth jellied cranberry sauce, not whole berry relish with seeds
